blocks.text:
HP Fast Charge
 In addition to long lasting battery life, this laptop optimizes charging to go from 0 to 50% in approximately 45 minutes.

Wi-Fi 6 (2x2) and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless card
 Expect faster speeds and improved performance for connecting multiple devices in your household.

Tuned Stereo Speakers
 Custom-tuned dual speakers are put through rigorous testing and refinement to deliver exceptional audio quality.

AI Noise Reduction
 Enjoy clearer team conversations with AI noise reduction. Using artificial intelligence, it filters out background noise in multi-person environments and captures multidirectional sound with spatial awareness.

HP True Vision HD Camera with Microphone Mute and Camera Shutter
 Video chat with vibrant clarity, even in low light. Temporal noise reduction ensures you're always heard. Security features make it easy to maintain your privacy by turning off your mic and blocking your camera.

Ports
 1 USB Type-C (5Gbps signaling rate), 2 USB Type-A (5Gbps signaling rate), 1 Headphone/microphone combo, 1 AC smart pin, 1 HDMI 1.4b

Weighs 3.52 lbs. and measures 0.73" thin
 A portable and lightweight design that fits perfectly in your lap, so you're never tethered to one place. 3-cell, 41 Wh Li-ion polymer battery.

Microsoft Copilot
 Do more with AI as your personal assistant. Kickstart new projects with relevant answers, simplified solutions, and helpful advice. Copilot in Windows 11 is ready to support you whenever and wherever you need it.

Making responsible choices
 Designed using responsible materials like ocean-bound and post-consumer recycled plastic to help drive progress toward a more sustainable future.

items: 【Designed for everyday needs】This HP 15.6" laptop features a Intel Processor N100 processor (up to 3.4 GHz with Intel Turbo Boost Technology, 6 MB L3 cache, 4 cores, 4 threads), which makes your work or study easy and convenient

【Display】The 15.6" 250nits Non-Touch Anti-glare, 45% NTSC LED display has a thin bezel and 85% screen-to-body ratio, which provides a comfortable viewing space for your videos, photos, and documents. Paired with Intel UHD Graphics, making the display colors more vivid and delicate

【Memory & Storage】16GB DDR4 SDRAM Memory; 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD allows to fast bootup and data transfer. It’s ideal for college students and business users needing ample space and speed. (Bundle with 128GB Portable SSD to USB)
【Microsoft Copilot】Microsoft Copilot gives you intelligent answers. Access with just the touch of the Copilot key.

【One year Microsoft 365 subscription included】Bring your ideas to life. Your creativity now gets a boost with Microsoft 365. Office - Word, Excel, and Power Point - now includes smart assistance features that help make your writing more readable, your data clearer and your presentations more visually powerful.

【Additional product features】Liberating battery life- Up to 11 hours and 45 minutes, HP Fast Charge, Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, Tuned stereo speakers, HP True Vision HD camera, Microphone mute & Camera shutter
